caption: The drawing depicts a vertically oriented rectangular pattern with a green border that features a repeating motif of small, curved lines resembling a stylized vine or scroll. Inside the border are alternating vertical stripes in tones of light gray and pale blue. In the central portion of the composition, there is a wide, off-white zigzag-edged stripe running vertically, within which a vine with green leaves and orange, bell-shaped flowers ascends from the bottom to the top. The floral vine is detailed with various shades of green for the leaves and stems, and the flowers have orange petals with yellow accents. The pattern is symmetric along the vertical axis and is rendered with solid, flat colors and fine brush strokes to depict the vegetal elements.
title: Wallpaper
